description: A fierce dragon that breathes scorching flames, capable of melting steel and incinerating forests.
A wise forest elf who channels nature magic to heal allies and grow enchanted vines.
An ancient ice golem summoned from glaciers, with an impenetrable frozen armor and freezing touch.
A stealthy shadow assassin who moves unseen through darkness, striking vital points with poisoned daggers.
A mighty storm giant wielding a thunderbolt hammer, capable of summoning lightning storms.
A gentle water sprite who purifies cursed lands and restores life to withered plants.
A cursed necromancer who raises fallen warriors as undead soldiers to fight once more.
A golden phoenix reborn from ashes, radiating blinding light and scorching heat.
A stone fortress wall that shields allies from incoming attacks and deflects projectiles.
A sea serpent lurking in ocean depths, capsizing ships with massive waves and crushing coils.
A wind archer mounted on a griffin, firing enchanted arrows that never miss their mark.
A plague doctor who spreads toxic miasma, weakening enemy troops and corroding their equipment.
